shapeSummary: 40 mm diameter, 7 mm wide three-spoke wheel with the axis along Z. It has an outer tire ring, a thinner inner plastic rim ring, three radial spokes at 120° spacing, and a central hub with a 4.8 mm through bore. It is centered at X=0 and Z=0, with the bottom at Y=0, so the wheel center sits at Y=20.
warnings: Dimensions come from the product listing, which is marked unverified.

Spoke width and thickness, hub diameter and length, rim width, and tire cross-section are estimated from the image.
